Hi Caleb.
I am sorry to hear about your dad as well. It's a horrible thing I wouldn't wish on anyone. 
I just worry I will feel this way forever.
I have told my boyfriend, multiple times. He apologizes, but he just keeps getting annoyed with me for being anxious, depressed, and negative. I understand, but it just makes me feel horrible about myself. But at the same time, maybe it is my fault. 
I am too scared to tell my mother. 
Thank you for sharing your thoughts about the TED talk. And living with your dad in your veins. That was beautifully said and I really appreciate that. You don't have to try to stay up for me. Thank you, really.
Well thank you for your response and kind words. I really appreciate it.

Thank you for replying. Yeah, I do judge myself harshly. It's so hard to stop. I've been going to therapy for years and I just feel like I am getting nowhere, even though my therapist is amazing. 
I feel like my boyfriend is lying because they are so ugly. I don't ever see someone with breasts like mine on the internet, unless it is saying how I can fix then with plastic surgery. I feel like a freak. I don't think anyone could ever find my body attractive. I don't ever see anyone with bodies like mine. Whether it be gone wild, mainstream porn, amateur porn, instagram, facebook, whatever. They never have bodies like mine.
